# Renew insurance and coordinate a claim

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before insurance renewal or when a loss may fall within an existing policy. An approved renewal decision or documented claim outcome with coverage, evidence and ongoing actions assigned.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Inventory policies and the relevant change or event

agent-runnable


Collect policies, endorsements, insured entities, renewal terms and business changes or loss facts. Preserve evidence and record dates from the actual documents without assuming coverage.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review coverage and notice requirements with the broker

human · human approval required


The insurance owner and qualified adviser assess exclusions, limits, deductibles, notification and renewal questions. For a claim, verify the insurer channel and obtain advice before admissions or settlements.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the renewal or claim evidence pack

agent-runnable


For renewal, reconcile exposures, staffing, revenue and requested cover. For a claim, compile the permitted incident, financial and supporting evidence, keeping estimates and confirmed losses separate.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the submission and any commitment

human · human approval required


Authorized people review the disclosures, terms or claim statement before delivery. Approve premiums, settlement terms or mitigation spending separately through their applicable authority.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Verify the resulting coverage or claim status

agent-runnable


Retain the issued policy or insurer response, reconcile costs and conditions and assign unresolved information requests. Calendar renewal or claim follow-up and update the company's risk controls.

- Verify: An approved renewal decision or documented claim outcome with coverage, evidence and ongoing actions assigned.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)
